descriptions.en: Right palm opens upward toward the listener, pauses to invite a response, then gently lowers without beckoning fingers.

profiles.description: Right palm opens calmly forward and slightly downward in a supportive arc; stable torso, no reaching beyond the stage.

descriptions.en: Right palm opens calmly forward and slightly downward in a supportive arc; stable torso, no reaching beyond the stage.

descriptions.en: Both hands open a little near the lower chest in quiet delight, shoulders soft, then release.

descriptions.en: Both softly curved hands gather before the waist without interlacing or touching, briefly hold, then release.

profiles.description: A small forward inclination with right palm slightly open, then torso and hand return together.

profiles.description: Both hands lift slightly and fingers open softly for a small surprise, then lower without stepping backward.

descriptions.en: Both hands lift slightly and fingers open softly for a small surprise, then lower without stepping backward.

profiles.description: Right palm gently supports the listener with softly gathered fingers; restrained openness, no dismissive movement.

profiles.description: Only the right arm bends below the chest with a gently flexed wrist and soft curled fingers like a fox paw, then releases.

descriptions.en: Only the right arm bends below the chest with a gently flexed wrist and soft curled fingers like a fox paw, then releases.

profiles.description: Right hand approaches a space before the lips without contact, then turns outward and opens for an air kiss before lowering.

descriptions.en: Right hand approaches a space before the lips without contact, then turns outward and opens for an air kiss before lowering.

profiles.description: Both shoulders and forearms open moderately for a small standing stretch below shoulder height, then completely return.

profiles.description: One bounded full-body turn with alternating foot support.

descriptions.en: One full turn with weight transfer and alternating steps. Procedural kinematics; visual acceptance pending.

profiles.description: The right hand makes a small greeting wave beside the cheek, outside the face, then lowers.

descriptions.en: The right index finger points upward beside the cheek for one small explanatory beat, elbow stays below the shoulder, then the hand lowers.
